description: The source of an AudioWorklet processor that plays one of several audio.js manifests (the audio.js of an @audio/* package): the model sent by message, a parameter it reads as it plays changed at once, a model made again for one it is made with, warmed on the last 100 ms and faded in, its state brought back to rest on silence, and a meter of the gain it takes off.
name: manifest-worklet
